instrument: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
part: Schedule (conditions for which advertisement of cure, prevention or diagnosis is prohibited)
provenance_note: Compiled from the India Code text of the Act cross-checked against two independent secondary listings. The India Code PDF was not directly retrievable at compile time. DMRA-001 remains in shadow_mode until the Resource Curator verifies this list against the Gazette text and sets verified to true.
amendment_note: Section 3 of the Act separately prohibits advertising for procuring miscarriage, preventing conception, correcting menstrual disorders, and improving or maintaining the capacity for sexual pleasure. These are statutory prohibitions in their own right, not Schedule entries, and are carried in section_3_prohibitions below. The Schedule may be amended by notification, so this file has a refresh cadence like any other regulatory data.
conditions: diseases and disorders of the brain
diseases and disorders of the optical system
diseases and disorders of the uterus
form and structure of the female bust
ulcers of the stomach and intestines
section_3_prohibitions: improving or maintaining the capacity for sexual pleasure
